working.instructions: Make one bounded contribution. Keep the current contributor, exact files or ports being relinquished, evidence, open issues, and next action ready for the handoff.

ready-for-review.instructions: Inspect the pinned artifact and handoff message. Record requested revisions by returning the marker to working, or record an explicit accepted decision in a message before advancing.

accepted.instructions: This records the accepted decision and the linked evidence; it does not establish independent review or quality.

transitions.label: publish handoff
transitions.instructions: Attach a pinned artifact and a handoff message naming the current and next contributor, exact files or ports relinquished, checks or evidence, open issues, and next action.

transitions.label: request revisions
transitions.instructions: Record the revision request in a coordination message, identify the next contributor and scope, then resume bounded work.

transitions.label: record accepted decision
transitions.instructions: Attach a message that explicitly records the accepted decision and any remaining follow-up.
